nodes.text: @SharylAttkisson Hospitals should be testing when people are admitted, so they would know whether it is flu etc. Human metapneumovirus acts similar to covid, flu, &presents w a lot of mucous, bronchitis, affects upper/lower respiratory system, and can cause hospitalization in even the healthiest.
